title: Freeze and thaw with viability outcomes
summary: Record a synthetic viable harvest, prepare and aliquot 10% DMSO freeze medium, control cooling and vapour storage, then thaw, dilute, remove DMSO, recount and quarantine one same-run stock.
scenario: A generic synthetic non-human mammalian harvest supplies four cryovials under no-loss accounting. Prepare 4.00 mL final freeze medium with 10% v/v DMSO at 4 °C, add cold and dropwise, cool at about 1 °C/min with a controlled-rate or passive container, transfer to vapour storage and record the address. Thaw one vial rapidly at 37 °C, dilute gradually, remove DMSO, recount and retain quarantine pending QC. Seeded post-thaw panels and penalties are synthetic.
guided_steps: Record 2.00 × 10⁶ viable cells/mL, 95.0% viability and 5.00 mL suspension. The viable harvest is 1.00 × 10⁷ cells.
Prepare 4.00 mL final medium: 0.400 mL DMSO + 3.60 mL base at 4 °C. Add DMSO by cold_dropwise with mixing in no more than 5 min.
Aliquot four vials, each 1.00 mL with 2.50 × 10⁶ viable cells. The batch concentration is 2.50 × 10⁶ viable cells/mL.
Use controlled_rate or passive_container, nominal 1.0 °C/min (accepted numerical range 0.8–1.2), −80 °C for 16 h. Uncontrolled freezer placement is a mistake.
Transfer to vapour at a displayed −150 °C and record dewar CRYO-A, rack R-02, box B-07, position D4, working_stock. Liquid immersion is a separate safety mistake.
Thaw one vial at 37 °C for 45 s to small_ice_remains; do not exceed 60 s.
Add 9.00 mL complete medium gradually at 37 °C. This makes a tenfold dilution and 1.00% DMSO.
Collect at 200 × g for 5 min, remove supernatant and resuspend in 2.00 mL. The synthetic accounting assumes 95% DMSO-solute removal, leaving 0.250% v/v.

Read the synthetic recovery panel and enter viable cells recovered, viability and viable concentration. A 92% panel yields 2.421053 × 10⁶ viable cells and 1.210526 × 10⁶ cells/mL; 93% varies with the seed.

Select quarantine_pending_qc, sterility pending, identity reference_on_file, and lesson_8_bank_ledger. Finish for 15 formative checkpoints and the structured result. No future growth or QC release is inferred.

limitations: All cells, counts, locations and outcomes are synthetic and non-human. The model rehearses decisions and arithmetic only.
The simulator establishes no competency, aseptic or cryogenic hand skill, institutional authorisation, stock-release decision or physical validation.

The exact formulation, densities, temperatures, timing bounds, IDs, hidden baseline and penalties, 95% solute removal, viability threshold and numerical tolerances are simulation choices, not laboratory acceptance criteria.
The viability factors are deterministic tally transformations, not validated DMSO-toxicity, osmotic, heat-transfer, ice-nucleation, recrystallisation or cell-survival models.
Vapour-phase selection is a conceptual safety decision only. Vial design, nitrogen handling, personal protection, dewar operation and local biohazard rules are not simulated.

Dye-exclusion viability represents membrane integrity at one count. Total-cell conservation and recovery calculations are assumptions; no attachment, growth, phenotype, genomic stability, identity, sterility or future viability is predicted.

The protocol covers one DMSO slow-freeze pathway only. Non-permeating agents are conceptual in the reading; vitrification, controlled nucleation, cell-specific optimisation, mycoplasma methods and full bank release/audit procedures are outside scope.
